title: 1997 AHSME Problem 2
statement: The adjacent sides of the decagon shown meet at right angles. What is its perimeter?

solutions.text: The total of the rightward horizontal sides is \(12,\) so all horizontal sides total \(24.\) The full height is \(8+2=10,\) so the vertical sides total \(20.\) Therefore the perimeter is \(24+20=44,\) and the correct answer is D.
hints: The unlabeled rightward horizontal lengths together equal the bottom width
Find the total vertical extent by combining the labeled height and the upper step
